renderer.root: dumpster-blocks flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-3 break-words break-keep font-sans text-base leading-[1.7] text-slate-700

inline.url: text-accent-700 underline decoration-accent-300 underline-offset-[3px] transition-colors hover:decoration-accent-600
inline.doc: rounded-[3px] font-medium text-accent-700 underline decoration-accent-300 underline-offset-[3px] transition-colors hover:bg-accent-50 hover:decoration-accent-600

list.checkbox: peer m-0 h-full w-full cursor-default appearance-none rounded-[4px] border-[1.5px] border-slate-300 bg-white checked:border-accent-600 checked:bg-accent-600
list.checkMark: pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 m-auto h-[0.72em] w-[0.72em] text-white

blockquote.quote: flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-2 border-l-[3px] border-slate-300 py-0.5 pl-4 text-slate-600

callout.head: flex items-start gap-2 font-semibold [&_strong]:text-inherit
callout.summary: cursor-pointer select-none list-none [&::-webkit-details-marker]:hidden -mt-3 -mb-2 rounded-t-lg pb-2 pt-3 scroll-mt-[var(--stick-top,0px)] [[open]>&]:sticky [[open]>&]:top-[var(--stick-top,0px)] [[open]>&]:z-[5] [[open]>&]:[background:linear-gradient(var(--callout-tint),var(--callout-tint)),var(--page-bg)] [[open]_[open]>&]:static [[open]_[open]>&]:[background:none]
callout.title: min-w-0
callout.chevron: mt-[0.35em] h-[1em] w-[1em] shrink-0 opacity-70 transition-transform duration-200 [details[open]>summary>&]:rotate-90

code.box: group/code relative min-w-0 overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-code-border bg-code-bg text-code-fg
code.label: flex h-9 select-none items-center border-b border-code-border px-4 font-mono text-[0.6875em] uppercase tracking-wider text-code-muted
code.copy: absolute right-1.5 top-1 z-10 inline-flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-code-border bg-code-bg text-code-muted opacity-0 transition hover:text-code-fg focus-visible:opacity-100 group-hover/code:opacity-100 [@media(hover:none)]:opacity-100
code.pre: overflow-x-auto overscroll-x-contain px-4 py-3 font-mono text-[0.8125em] leading-[1.6] [tab-size:4]

table.wrap: overflow-x-auto overscroll-x-contain min-w-0 rounded-lg border border-slate-200
table.th: min-w-[5em] whitespace-pre-wrap border-b border-r border-slate-200 bg-slate-500/[0.05] px-3 py-2 align-bottom font-semibold text-slate-800 last:border-r-0
table.td: min-w-[5em] whitespace-pre-wrap border-b border-r border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 align-top last:border-r-0

bookmark.card: flex min-w-0 items-stretch overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white no-underline transition-colors hover:bg-slate-50
bookmark.body: flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-1 px-3.5 py-3
bookmark.title: truncate text-[0.875em] font-medium text-slate-800
bookmark.url: mt-0.5 flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1.5 text-[0.75em] text-slate-400

embed.card: flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[0.9375em]
embed.active: bg-white text-slate-800 no-underline transition-colors hover:border-accent-300 hover:bg-accent-50
embed.label: min-w-0 flex-1 truncate font-medium

unsupported.box: min-w-0 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-slate-50
unsupported.head: flex items-center gap-2 px-3 pt-2 text-[0.6875em]
unsupported.reason: rounded bg-amber-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-medium text-amber-800
unsupported.raw: overflow-x-auto overscroll-x-contain whitespace-pre-wrap px-3 pb-2.5 pt-1.5 font-mono text-[0.8125em] leading-[1.6] text-slate-600
